title: The guards' one-on-one strength as knobs
note: Ours, not the rules package's: three candidate settings for the combat rules' trained guard (rudolfGuard, rapier and kite shield, sandbox.guard_trained: Strength 21, Dexterity 26, Stamina 25, Melee 2) and the night watchman (rudolfGuard, broadsword, sandbox.watchman: Strength 70, Dexterity 45, Stamina 70, Melee 3), each found so the player's own sheet (sandbox.player, Melee 0, Christof's BroadSword) beats one of them about 60, 70 and 80 % of the time (200 bouts, seeds from 3000). Guards are not necessarily hard, but powerful enough that a human or fledgling player does not go wild on the townsfolk; the real danger is being overwhelmed by too many foes. The defaults are NOT changed: a candidate is an arena spec's fighter (its sheet's values over the template, its duelling brain's numbers), made by guard_candidates.py (beside it), to choose from. The levers: values (the sheet's purchased ratings: strength is how hard each blow lands, stamina its soak, melee its tempo, guard, riposte and shield read), brain.pace (the pause after each run of blows, seconds, least and most: the guards' kind is 1.0 to 2.2, the townsfolk's 2 to 4) and brain.blockChance (the chance its brain raises its guard against a blow, before the guard by skill's factor and the response scale: 0.5 by default); armor is also taken (an arena armor list). Not an arena spec: the arena's specs are the .json files directly in tools/platform/arena.

c60.note: The guard: Strength 21 to 12 (his blows land about as a weak man's), Melee 2 to 1 (still trained: he guards with his blade), pauses 2.2-4.0 s, block chance halved. The watchman as built (the player already beats him 60.5 %).

c70.note: The guard: as c60 and Strength 8, Stamina 25 to 15 (less soak). The watchman: his sheet as built, pauses 2.2-4.0 s, block chance halved.

c80.note: The guard: as c70 and Strength 6, Stamina 12. The watchman: as c70 and Strength 70 to 50, Melee 3 to 2.
